gcp_us_east4.hyperdisk-balanced_note: N4D accepts only Hyperdisk (pd-balanced is rejected by the API). Pool uses hyperdisk-balanced 75 GiB at the included baseline 3000 IOPS / 140 MiB/s, so only capacity is billed (Cloud Billing catalog, us-east4, 2026-10-01). pd-balanced $0.11 kept for reference.
gcp_us_east4.pool_cost_model: pool $/s x occupancy / utilisation, from pool-log.csv uptime

next_size_note: Next memory size at 2 vCPU, for workloads that need more than 8 GiB without swap: EC2 r8a.large (2 vCPU / 16 GiB), GCE n4d-highmem-2 (2 vCPU / 16 GiB: 2 x $0.02911 core-h + 16 x $0.00331 GiB-h). Prices from the AWS Price List API and the Cloud Billing catalog, 2026-10-01.
